chips.title: P5 receiver-fitted carry
chips.summary: Compile the carry for the receiving substrate from canonical history, report unaccounted drops, ask for self-model restatement, and land it on master.

evidence.message: ADR 0004 (2026-09-20) rules that TORC owns what a lineage carries to its next bearer; the compiler and self-model become the main line of work.
Branch commits of 2026-09-20 add compiler p5-1, history reading with unaccounted drops, revision resolutions, boundary asks, a session-start carry command, and 14 carry tests.
Not merged to master as of 2026-09-27. Branch test run and CI matrix result unverified by this assessment; only the checked-out 2026-09-03 commit was run (192 passed).
